fundamental.summary: TXN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 62 days adds timing risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with VIX in crisis territory (378.4), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, and earnings event 62 days out creates hostile trading environment for TXN.

debate.key_bull_argument: SMA 9/21 golden cross with rising RSI and supertrend bullish signal short-term momentum reversal, amplified by extreme fear sentiment (10/10) creating contrarian buy opportunity near support at 148.71.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains structurally weak below SMA 50/200 and Ichimoku cloud with weak ADX (21.76), zero fundamental catalysts, high earnings risk in 62 days, and VIX crisis (378.4) creating hostile macro environment that invalidates tactical momentum signals.
